description: Angular component for configuring credentials in a rule node, including form handling, validation, and dynamic UI updates.

classes.name: CredentialsConfig
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of credentials configuration data.

classes.name: CredentialsConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing credentials configuration form, validation, and state.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, especially for disabling certain credential types.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with provided credentials data.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates the external model based on form values.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating form value changes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form and returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: credentialsTypeChanged
methods.description: Resets form fields when credential type changes.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically sets validators based on credential type.

methods.name: requiredFilesSelected
methods.description: Custom validator to ensure required file fields are selected.
